gaps.wanted: The QFX5240 line datasheet, which covers the QFX5241. Its address redirects to an HPE document server that refused every request made for this change. Nothing here is the datasheet's; the figures are the guide's.
The depth of the fan module and of the power supplies. The guide's figures 21 to 28 carry no scale and its tables state weights only for the whole chassis.

The chassis width. The guide's Table 9 says 19.03 in (48.33 cm), which is 17.26 in plus the front brackets; the 32OD guide's Table 10 says 17.26 in (43.84 cm) for its 1U body, and the QFX5240-64QD sibling carries 17.26 in. The body is 17.26 in because the photograph's scale is consistent with it and 19.03 in would not be.

A photograph of the DC build. The guide's figure 10 is an isometric drawing and figure 22 a flat drawing of the DC FRU panel with no scale and no colour, so the DC supply is drawn from figure 22 and estimated.

The ORv3 switch-tray assembly QFX5241-64QD-DO-T2 and its spare QFX5241-64QD-TCHAS: 21.14 x 3.65 x 31.71 in (Table 9), drawn only in isometric (figure 11), a different envelope from this device. Not modelled.

The type of the two small cages. The guide's callout 2 and text call them "SFP28 ports" with a speed of 10 Gbps, which an SFP28 cage can run at 25 Gbps. They are modelled as sfp-plus at 10 Gbps as on the sibling, and no rate is printed on the metal.

Which ports take high power optics. The guide's note says that only the front-panel ports in the middle rows support them (first and fourth rows do not) and lists 1, 2, 5, 6, 9, 10 and so on to 61 and 62, which are ports of the second and third rows in a column of four, counting from 0. The note is carried in `features.optics-qsfp-dd` and the face does not mark those ports, because the metal does not.

The lamps of the management jack. Guide figure 20 and Table 12 describe lamps on the management port; the photograph shows them at the corners of the upper jack. The jack is drawn with the library's lamped jack.
The lamp of each SFP28 port. The guide's Table 13 gives each of the two ports one link-activity lamp; neither the photograph nor the guide's figures show where it is.

The connector type of the 1PPS and 10MHz jacks. The guide calls them "clock input and output connectors"; the photograph shows gold coaxial jacks 6 mm across, drawn as the library's SMA jack. Estimated.
The rating label of each supply and the serial number labels (figures 88 to 90). Not drawn.
The rack ears' positions and the rack kit's contract. The guide names QFX5240-2U-4PRMK and no kit contract exists in the library; none is written here.

a `power-draw-max-w` on each module this chassis accepts, from the vendor's own per-card table - Cisco publishes one per ambient, most vendors publish none, and until they land a module total is a floor
`physical-context` on 6 bays (rear 6); `physical-context` on port groups qsfpdd-800g, sfp-plus - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays

chassis.note: guide Table 9: 3.46 in (8.78 cm) high, 25.51 in (65 cm) deep and 48.50 lb (22 kg) fully loaded without optics, for the -AO and -DO builds alike. The inch figures are used: 87.9 x 648.0 mm. The table prints a width of 19.03 in (48.33 cm). That is the width over the front brackets and the rack-face width, as the QFX5240 sibling's datasheet and the 32OD guide's Table 10 (17.26 in for the 1U body) show; the photograph agrees (see gate-1), so the body is 17.26 in, 438.4 mm, and brackets are not modelled.

colour.note: The front plate samples #6b7480 (a bare patch near the foot, the value the QFX5240-64QD's identical photograph gives) and the rear panel #646d79. The chassis colour is the front's. The photographs are lit warmly and these are their values, not a paint reference.

drawing-vs-photo.note: The guide's figures 8 to 10 are line drawings of the same chassis; the photograph is followed for what is printed. The guide calls the SFP pair "SFP28 ports" in its callouts and text with a speed of 10 Gbps; the group is stated at sfp-plus and 10g, as on the sibling. The photograph shows the AC supplies' hubs carrying the supply maker's name; it is a third party's logo and is not drawn.

ears-and-kits.note: NOT MODELLED. The guide names the rack mount kit QFX5240-2U-4PRMK (a four-post tool-less kit, Table 8). The library holds no contract for it and none is written here, so `chassis.ears` and `chassis.kits` are left out and a gap says so. The modelled body is the 438.4 mm chassis, without brackets.

earthing.note: Two threaded studs 15.5 mm apart on a pad at the left of the rear, under the ground symbol, 6.4 mm from the left edge, as the QFX5240 sibling's photograph shows and this one repeats.

front-green-tab.note: The green tab at the foot of the management panel, 17.0 mm wide and 2.7 mm tall, is the chassis serial number pull-out (callout 8 of figure 13). It is drawn as decor, because it is a label card and not a part the library models.

gate-1.note: The front photograph's body, between the left and right edges, is 1893 px wide and 375 px from the top edge to the bottom lip, an aspect of 5.05 against 438.4 / 87.9 = 4.99 (1 percent out). Scale 4.318 px/mm across, used on both axes with the origin at the left edge (x 115 px) and the top edge (y 192 px). The rear photograph's body is 1895 px wide, 4.323 px/mm. Had 19.03 in been the body width the scale would be 3.92 px/mm and the cages 26.5 mm apart. The front photograph is the same size and geometry as the QFX5240-64QD's (the body 116 to 2008 px against 115 to 2007), so the positions of the QFX5240-64QD are carried and each was checked against this photograph.

lifecycle.note: The guide, published 2026-09-28, states no end-of-life announcement and none was found. The device states none announced. Estimated, because absence in the documents is not a notice from the maker.

logo.note: The maker's logo and its lockup are printed at the upper right of the face, above the model name QFX5241-64QD. The logo is not drawn: a logo-zone region is reserved where it stands, and the model name is drawn as plain text.

mgmt-panel.note: Right of the last column, from the top: the model name under the maker's logo, the RJ-45 management port with a USB-A port under it in one shield (MGMT, and the USB 3 symbol), the stacked SFP pair with 64 and 65 below it, a strip with the legends ID, SYS and ALM above three lamps and the RST pinhole, the 1PPS and 10MHz coaxial jacks, the RJ-45 console (CON) and time-of-day (TOD) jacks stacked in one shield, and a green serial-number tab at the foot (guide figure 13 callouts 1 to 9). The USB tongue is blue in the photograph, which is the USB-IF colour of a 3.0 port, and the guide says "USB 3.0 port".

modules.note: The four fan modules and the two power supplies are field-replaceable units in bays, each its own component (guide Table 8): QFX5240-2U-FANAO and QFX5240-PWR-AC-AO for the AC build, which are the QFX5240 components reused as they are, and QFX524X-2RU-FAN-O and QFX524X-2RU-PWR-DO for the DC build, which are new. Nothing on this chassis is a built-in unit that is not a bay. Each supply carries its own small fan inside.

port-lamps.note: Each network port has a single RGB lamp (guide, Network Port LEDs, Table 10): in the photograph a dot 2.0 mm across at the left of each cage, at the height of the cage's centre, 1.85 mm left of the cell. The lamps are unlit. The photograph shows no lamp at the SFP ports, while the guide's Table 13 gives each SFP28 port one link-activity lamp; none is drawn.

port-numbering.note: Printed on a strip above the upper band and a strip below the lower band, read off the photograph: over each column "N up-arrow ... down-arrow N+1" with N a multiple of four, and under each column the same with N+2. So a column holds ports 4c to 4c+3 from the top, the upper band's pair first; the SFP pair prints "64 up-arrow" and "down-arrow 65" under it. The guide's figure 13 callout 2 names them SFP28 ports, and its text gives them a speed of 10 Gbps. Interface names are not printed and none is stated in the guide, so they are not recorded.

ports.note: Front photograph: 64 QSFP-DD openings, sixteen columns of four on a 103.7 px pitch, 24.01 mm, each opening 80 px (18.5 mm) wide; the cage cell is the registry's 19.0 mm, set so the opening centres agree, and the first cell starts at 11.35 mm. A column holds two stacked pairs, one above the other, with a gap between them (figures 8 and 13). The two SFP cages stand to the right of the last column, stacked, one above the other (callout 2, 14.5 mm wide).

power.note: Guide, Power System: typical 616 W and maximum 2258 W for the QFX5241-64QD (613 W and 2198 W for the 64OD), with 1+1 supplies. AC input: Table 6 says 200 to 240 VAC at 16 A for the QFX5240-PWR-AC-AO, 3000 W from 215 to 240 VAC and 2800 W from 200 to 214 VAC. DC: Table 6 and Table 17 say -48 to -60 VDC, 80 A maximum a supply, 3000 W out at 12.2 V.

rear-layout.note: Rear photograph at 4.323 px/mm (the body width as on the QFX5240 sibling), checked against the guide's figure 21: two supplies stacked at the left end, supply 0 above supply 1, an earthing pad with two studs and the ground symbol under them, then four fan modules numbered 0 to 3 from the left on an 85.7 mm pitch. A fan symbol, the module number and an arrow are printed beside each fan opening, and a power symbol with the supply number beside each supply. The fan plates measure 80.3 mm wide and 80.0 mm high; the supplies 73.7 mm wide and 39.5 mm high. The photograph is of the AC build, and agrees in size and geometry with the 64OD's rear photograph. The guide's figure 22 (DC FRU panel, flat) draws the DC build with the same bays, fan plates and legends and a different supply face; no photograph of the DC build is held.

row-pitch.note: Down column 5 the four openings centre at 18.5, 35.9, 52.1 and 69.5 mm: 17.4 mm between the two cages of a pair, 16.2 mm from a pair to the next, so the rows are laid on 17.4 mm inside each band, the upper band 13.5 mm and the lower 47.1 mm from the top. The registry gives no belly-to-belly pitch for a QSFP-DD cage.

sources.note: QFX5241-64OD and QFX5241-64QD Switches Hardware Guide, published 2026-09-28, 223 pages (Hewlett Packard Enterprise, for Juniper Networks), from https://www.juniper.net/documentation/us/en/hardware/qfx5241-64odqd/qfx5241-64odqd.pdf: the front and rear figures 8 to 11, the port panel figures 13 and 15 and Table 10 (lamps), Table 4 (variants), Tables 6 to 8 (power and cooling), Table 9 (physical specifications) and figures 21 and 22 (the AC and DC FRU panels). The QFX5241-32OD Switch Hardware Guide, published 2026-10-11, 199 pages, from https://www.juniper.net/documentation/us/en/hardware/qfx5241-32od/qfx5241-32od.pdf, for its Table 10 body width of 17.26 in. Juniper's studio photographs of the 64QD, front and rear (qfx5241-64qd-front-high.jpg, 2100 x 735 px, and qfx5241-64qd-rear-high.jpg, 2100 x 692 px, from juniper.net's image library). The documents and the photographs are the maker's and public; the guides carry a copyright notice and no terms of use beyond it, and the image library page carries none, so only facts are transcribed. The QFX5240 line datasheet, which covers the QFX5241, could not be fetched: its address redirects to an HPE document server that refused every request made for this change, so no figure here is the datasheet's. No Visio stencil, 3D model or mechanical drawing is held for the QFX5241. The guide's figures 8 to 10 are line-drawn isometric views and figures 13, 21 and 22 are flat drawings; the flat drawings are used to count and read and the photographs to measure.

stack-orientation.note: The photograph shows the grey latch mesh between the two cages of every pair, so both lips face the band between them: the upper cage upright and the lower one turned 180, the library's stack convention. The convention is applied, not observed. The SFP pair is the same.

variants.note: Guide Table 4 and the spare chassis table: QFX5241-64QD-AO (AC, airflow out), QFX5241-64QD-DO (DC, airflow out) and the spare QFX5241-64QD-CHAS, "Spare chassis without PSUs and fans". They share this front panel and the rear bays, so each is a configuration of this device. NOT MODELLED: the ORv3 build QFX5241-64QD-DO-T2 (the guide's overview also writes it QFX5240-64QD-DO-T2) and its spare QFX5241-64QD-TCHAS. They are the same switch in a 2 OU Open Rack V3 switch-tray assembly, 21.14 x 3.65 x 31.71 in and 31.29 kg (Table 9), a different envelope that a configuration cannot state, drawn in the guide only in isometric (figure 11), with fans and supplies that cannot be changed while operating.

vents.note: Hexagonal holes in the sheet: a band along the top above the cages, a band along the bottom, a column at the left edge, a column at the right edge and a field under the clock connectors. Drawn as vent decor in those positions, pitched to the photograph and estimated.
